references.title: Thoracic anatomy reference targets; no reference pixels copied

failure.en: The shallow cap was too schematic for the requested detailed anatomy; initial new-source lighting also hid curvature.
failure.zh: 浅穹顶过于示意化，未达到所需的精细解剖展示；新来源模型最初的灯光也掩盖了曲率。

cause.en: Coverage and technical export checks were mistaken for sufficient visual quality; smooth geometry and bright lighting reduced anatomical readability.
cause.zh: 覆盖数量与导出技术检查被误当作足够的视觉质量证据；平滑表面与过亮灯光降低了解剖结构的可辨性。

fix.en: Added a separate unchanged Z-Anatomy static study with native skeletal context and lower-exposure diagnostics. Baseline and its animation remain unchanged; no invented repairs.
fix.zh: 新增独立的 Z-Anatomy 静态研究，保留原始几何与同源骨骼位置，并降低诊断渲染的曝光感。原基线及其动画未变，未凭空修补解剖结构。

retest.en: Reviewed 9 views and baseline comparison; checked source fidelity, native axes, repeatable exports and geometry roundtrip. Accepted only gross static shape/regional localization; anatomy, runtime and motion remain unverified.
retest.zh: 复核 9 个视角与基线对比，检查源几何一致性、原生坐标轴、导出可重复性及几何往返一致性。仅认可静态大体形态与区域定位；解剖准确性、运行时与运动仍未验证。

lesson.en: Review silhouettes, undersides and coherent context before expanding coverage. A clean export is not an anatomy pass; retain unexplained source features and label limits.
lesson.zh: 扩充覆盖前，先检查轮廓、下表面与一致的上下文。导出通过不等于解剖通过；保留尚未解释的源特征，并明确限制。

scope.en: Smooth source anatomy; unnamed openings and unexplained narrow projections retained. Partial ribs/sternum/spine context omits cartilage and much of thorax. Not final detailed anatomy or breathing motion.
scope.zh: 源解剖表面较平滑；保留未命名开口及尚未解释的细长突出结构。肋骨、胸骨与脊柱上下文不完整，缺少软骨与大部分胸廓。并非最终精细解剖模型或呼吸运动模型。

integrationClarification: Package approval received after original decision file; original awaiting-package-review wording preserved as history. Current acceptance remains gross static shape/localization only.
